lines.sub: Spoiled produce is a planning problem.
It decides what ships first, and where.
Twenty six batches, six markets, one day.
Money, waste, and demand met come first.
It beats a careful human dispatcher.
Most perishable first, with a reason each.
Discounts appear only where they pay.
It replans at once, zero rule breaks.
Thirty bad days, it still wins.
On hidden data, spoilage falls thirty eight percent.
Open assumptions and tested code: FreshRoute.
